early_pay.quote: If the Buyer pays the delivery payment early, within five (5) days of Delivery, the Seller grants a discount of 2% of that payment

assumptions: A month is counted as 30 days and business days as calendar days: for a payment, the earlier reading.
The contract's payment terms are not added on top of a milestone: each milestone falls due on the day its own words give.
Days marked as yours rest on your timeline (signing, delivery, acceptance, invoice), not on the contract's text.
